description: The open data portal of İzmir Metropolitan Municipality lists about 250 datasets, 57 of them in the mobility group, from the transport department, the ESHOT bus company, İzmir Metro and other units. Transport datasets include public transport GTFS feeds, bus stops, bus lines and their routes, departure times, line announcements, bus lines connecting to metro, İZBAN, ferries, the airport and the bus terminal, fare tariffs and a nearby-stops API, with metro and tram data. Many ESHOT datasets were updated in September 2026. Coverage is one city (İzmir). The data are free to download as CSV and ZIP files and through the portal's CKAN API, mostly under the İzmir Metropolitan Municipality open data licence, with some under CC BY and some without a stated licence. Caveats: formats and update rates differ by publisher, and only part of the catalogue concerns transport. The datasets support public transport network models, accessibility and disruption analysis for a large port city, and emergency planning. They complement the Istanbul public transport ridership data and are related to the GTFS specification.
